title: s500-generic-45: Letter and word selective SEEG responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex, fast periodic visual stimulation (Lochy et al., 2018) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 37 patients with refractory epilepsy viewing fast periodic visual stimulation, in which words appeared at 2 Hz among pseudofonts, nonwords or pseudowords presented at 10 Hz. The dataset probes letter- and word-selective responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex, measured at 2 Hz and its harmonics. This derivative release repackages the authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 40 Hz and cut into sequences, in BIDS format with electrode coordinates in Talairach and MNI space.
methods_description: Intracerebral SEEG was recorded with Micromed systems at the University Hospital of Nancy while patients viewed fast periodic visual stimulation sequences (10 Hz base stimulation with a word every fifth item). The authors' Letswave 5 preprocessing applied a 40 Hz Butterworth low-pass filter (order 4) and cut sequences from 2 s after onset to about 68 s, an integer number of 2 Hz cycles. Sequences of one condition were merged into one file, then repackaged to BrainVision with events and electrode coordinates.
